summary: Destruction on curse duty for the raid, casting Curse of the Elements (one curse duty per warlock; other warlocks cover the other curses): the warlock keeps its own Curse of the Elements (rank 4, 10% magic damage taken) up all fight, cast right after the opener and recast before it drops, and the raid's is off. Under Forever the curse has its own slot, so the bane stays. Costs 13.0 DPS at 180 s against the base build.
rotation: Pre-pull: Shadow Bolt at -2.5 s (lands just after the pull)
Life Tap below 5% mana or when the filler costs more than the mana left
Curse of the Elements on duty for the raid, right after the opener and recast before it drops
Bane of Doom when it lands before the fight ends (more than 60 s left)
Bane of Agony while Bane of Doom is on cooldown or would not land
Corruption when it is down (more than 9 s left)
Immolate when down or when less than its cast time remains
Conflagrate on cooldown while Immolate is up
Death Coil, then Searing Pain, when the filler would not land before the fight ends
caveats: Under Forever a bane and a curse are separate slots, so the duty curse costs only its GCDs and mana, not the bane.

Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 38 spell power and 13 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Demon sensitivity: no owner scaling 946.1, Succubus melee halved 947.4, both 922.9 (first set)
Succubus 984.9 vs Felhunter 960.1, Imp 950.7, no demon 895.4; Spellstone and Firestone within 0.1 (first set)
Demon scaling uses Season of Discovery placeholder coefficients (Forever's are server-side): worth +49 on Demonology, +39 on the other builds
Succubus base melee is unverified: halved melee would cost Demonology 43, the other builds 38 to 39
Bane of Doom coefficient 4.0 (Era 1.0) is about 12% of Shadow Bolt builds' damage; at 2.0 they lose about 4%, at 1.0 about 6%
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Shadow Bolt IX, Immolate VII, Corruption VI): 7 to 13 DPS below rank X/VIII/VII
Only the Demonheart Raiment 2-piece is live (the 5-piece added about +8 to +13 on the first set)
Soul shards and Life Tap health cost are not tracked
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as warlock__destruction except -apl level60_destruction_duty_curse, then raid.debuffs.curseOfElements set to false. Demon Armor; Summon Succubus, sacrificed NoSummon, imbue Spellstone. mksettings sets distanceFromTarget 5 / channelClipDelayMs 50 where the UI preset uses 25 / 150; the published numbers were made with mksettings and reproduce exactly.
